class_mappings.rationale: EMMO 1.0.3 declares no Alloy class. MetallicMaterial is the nearest safe superclass and explicitly notes that metallic materials often form alloys; it also includes pure metals.
PRISM element nodes are element names or symbols; EMMO defines ChemicalElement as the symbol for a specific chemical element.
The upstream class has skos:altLabel Phase.
EMMO 1.0.3 declares no Paper class. Document is a broader graphical-document class; no local bibo paper class is declared.

materialised_conclusions.purpose: Makes the CONTAINS/hasChemicalSpecies object range compatible with PRISM Element nodes without a runtime OWL 2 DL reasoner.

derivation.semantics: Complete explicit named rdfs:subClassOf ancestry plus the documented named-member conclusion from ChemicalSpecies' owl:equivalentClass/owl:unionOf axiom. No other OWL restrictions, equivalences, unions, or property chains are inferred.

source_compatibility_repairs.change: Replace the erroneous predicate-list terminator after the otherunits import with a semicolon; line 23 continues the same ontology subject with dcterms:abstract.
source_compatibility_repairs.reason: The pinned upstream byte is a period, making line 23 invalid Turtle; Sophia correctly rejects it. The source scratch file is not modified.

modifications: PRISM selected and deterministically re-serialized the required declarations and named ancestry, and added the documented OWL-entailed ChemicalElement-to-ChemicalSpecies subclass conclusion. The upstream source files are not modified.

relation_mappings.rationale: Direct Substance-to-ChemicalSpecies relation matching PRISM's material-to-element edge. The artifact materialises the OWL-entailed ChemicalElement rdfs:subClassOf ChemicalSpecies conclusion required for range compatibility.
Direct upstream semiotic relation from an object to a property.
Upstream relation from a manufactured product to the manufacturing process used to make it. It implies the PRISM source is a manufactured product.
Exact direction and general mereological meaning.
EMMO 1.0.3 declares no hasPhase property. hasConstituent is a generic physical object-to-spatial-part relation and is valid only when the phase is modeled as a constituent region.

source_input_sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 over PRISM EMMO source input v1 framing of each sorted relative path and byte payload: 58 Turtle files plus LICENSE

unresolved.rationale: No Author class is declared locally. foaf:Person is referenced and given an RDFS parent but is not locally asserted owl:Class and does not capture the author role.
The current extraction direction and intended observation bearer are underspecified; no exact local object property is declared.
